title: Iron Status in Women of Reproductive Age Reproductive Age
brief_summary: Analyzed iron status, HFE mutations and ethnicity for women in five primary care centers in the United States and Canada using de-identified data from the HEIRS study.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. primary care women included in the HEIRS study with in the age range of this study
2. Self designation as Asian American, African American, Hispanic American or White.

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Age \>44 years
2. Self-described ethnicity other in than inclusion criterion 2.
study_population: Primary care women included in the HEIRS study.
